title: A calmer way to read English
summary: Deep reading feels easier when vocabulary help stays close to the article instead of pulling the learner away.
translation: 当词汇帮助始终贴着文章出现时，精读会比不停切换工具轻松得多。

sentences.text: Many learners can read part of an English article, but they lose confidence when the meaning starts to blur.
A better reading tool keeps the explanation close to the sentence, so the learner stays inside the story.
When the reader feels absorbed instead of interrupted, deep reading becomes much more sustainable.

grammarPoints.title: when 引导时间从句
grammarPoints.explanation: 用 when 把发生的时刻和结果连起来，帮助读者理解因果顺序。

difficultSentences.breakdown: 主句说明很多学习者能读懂一部分，but 后面补充他们在意思变模糊时会失去信心。

quiz.question: What problem does the article describe first?
choices: Learners lose confidence when meaning becomes unclear
quiz.explanation: The first sentence says learners lose confidence when meaning starts to blur.

quiz.question: Why should explanations stay close to the sentence?
choices: To keep the learner inside the story
quiz.explanation: The article says nearby explanations help the learner stay inside the story.

quiz.question: What makes deep reading more sustainable?
quiz.explanation: The last sentence states that feeling absorbed instead of interrupted makes deep reading sustainable.
